messages:
Devon: Postmortem follow-up: p95 latency spike tied to the A/B experiment. I'll collect owners and timelines here.

Maya: Do we change the SLO or apply operational mitigations first?

Devon: Operational mitigations first. Keep SLOs for now. Add per-variant p95 dashboards, stricter alerts, and an error-budget guardrail.

Samir: I'll own service fixes. Hotfix: bump KV cache TTL + add jitter (72h). Full fix: eviction refactor and better key sharding (~2w). I'll post PRs.

Kelsey: Obs owner. I'll add per-variant p50/p95/p99, error-budget panels, and deploy overlay. ETA 3 business days. Starting PromQL: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_latency_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, variant))

Priya: I will draft customer-facing language + internal FAQ for CSMs. Target EOD Friday. Looping legal.

Devon: Action list: Dashboard & alerts: Kelsey (3d); Hotfix (TTL+jitter): Samir (72h); Full mitigation rollout: Samir (2w); Runbook + rollback steps: Devon (1w); Customer comms: Priya (EOD Fri).

Samir: Also adding runtime kill-switch: if variant error-budget burn >2% in 1h -> auto-fallback to baseline routing.

Oncall Bot: Incident logged: https://redwood/incident/INC-2026-314 (postmortem created).

InfraBot: Alert created: SLO:route_p95_high (prod) threshold=150ms -> notify=eng-oncall.

Kelsey: I'll group alerts under "variant-p95" and page eng-oncall. Will post dashboard links when live.

Devon: Freeze auto-deploys for the experiment for 48h pending mitigations. Kelsey add deploy overlay; Samir add kill-switch hook.

Maya: SLO owner sign-off required for any SLO edits. Devon, draft incident appendix & short-term policy. Target Mon EOD.

Priya: Flagging enterprise customers with active SLAs for prioritized comms. Draft will include one-paragraph summary and credit policy if error budget exceeded.

Samir: Hotfix work started; linking PR shortly. Technical note: KV cache thrash under high concurrency to small hot keyset. Hotfix is rollback-safe.

Devon: Recurrence note: this is the third p95 excursion in ~8 weeks tied to this experiment. If mitigations don't reduce incidents, we'll propose rollback at next SLO sync.

Devon: Final checklist: [x] Incident logged; [ ] Dashboards & alerts; [ ] Hotfix shipped; [ ] Full rollout; [ ] Runbook & SLO appendix; [ ] Customer comms; [ ] SLO owner sign-off. Reconvene at weekly SLO sync next Tue to decide on SLO target changes or SLA credits. If any ETA slips, post updates here.

Kelsey: Noted. Will post dashboard URLs and alert IDs when complete.

Samir: PR linked: will update status.

Devon: Thanks all — assigning in tracker and monitoring error-budget burn. Ping if blockers.
